    How the scoring works

    The opportunity index is 100 × (frequency + repeatability + verifiability + data readiness) / 12. Each input is scored from 0 to 3 with equal weight. These weights and thresholds are author-designed and have not been empirically validated.

    Controls are considered separately, so a high opportunity score cannot cancel a serious concern. Consequential decisions or hard-to-reverse actions trigger specialist review. Sensitive data or unavailable human review require safeguards first. Otherwise scores of 67+ suggest a limited pilot, 34–66 suggest assistive use, and lower scores suggest clarifying the process first.

    This prototype uses fixed rules, not an AI model. No input is sent to a server. It does not assess legal compliance, technical feasibility, cost or actual return on investment.

    Built by Aayan Khan · Learning prototype v1.0 · Example scenarios are synthetic.
    Use anonymous task descriptions. Validate assumptions with the people who do the work before making a real deployment decision.
